message: Live Windows 2.2.14 evidence: blank evidence worked exactly as intended. At blank_checks=6 the dispatcher logged action=rebind, rebind=create, page=rebind_create, but ~0.7s later failed reason=no_composer. Later polls correctly did not create more tabs. Fix as Dispatcher 2.2.15 in agent-handoff only. Requirements: (1) The new-chat rebind page must not test composer only once immediately after goto. Add a bounded composer hydration wait (e.g. up to 20s, polling) on the already-created marked rebind page. During the wait, detect signed-out and hard-unavailable states and fail closed; logs must remain text-free. (2) Preserve the one-page guarantee. For the current persisted state rebind_status=failed/rebind_count=1 with rebind_bootstrap_sent=false from 2.2.14, permit exactly one resume attempt on the existing REBIND_PAGE_MARK page; do NOT create another page for this resume. If that marked page is missing, fail closed rather than opening another tab. Add a separate persistent resume latch/counter so restart/polls cannot repeat resume indefinitely. For compatibility with the current 2.2.14 state, a legacy failed state with no stored failure reason may resume only when rebind_bootstrap_sent=false and the existing marked rebind page is present; signed-out/hard-unavailable checks still gate it. (3) Persist a stable rebind_failure_reason token for new failures (no_composer, signed_out, no_new_url, etc.), without logging UI text. (4) If composer appears during the bounded wait, send CONTROL_BOOTSTRAP exactly once only if rebind_bootstrap_sent is false, then wait for a real usable conversation URL and atomically commit rebind as before. Never persist ChatGPT home '/'. Never resend bootstrap if it was already sent. (5) Preserve recovery_used/recovery_reason/recovered_from/bootstrap history/GitHub state, clear only the appropriate blank/restore latches after successful rebind, and never navigate unrelated ChatGPT conversations. (6) Add tests for delayed composer becoming ready after several polls; persistent no-composer bounded failure; signed-out during wait; legacy 2.2.14 failed/no-bootstrap state resumes exactly once on existing marked page; missing marked page creates no new tab; bootstrap exactly once; successful URL persistence; restart/poll de-dup. Preserve CHECK_INTERVAL=5, 2.2.10 raw->api failover, main and arena/local-agent-v0 unchanged, no Phase 2/live mailbox. After commit write turn_id=47 target=GPT with SHA, changed files, exact tests and resume semantics.
